focus: Scattered Spider / UNC3944 MFA push bombing against Okta and Salesforce admin accounts
signal_source: cloud_cluster: 'Scattered Spider Targets Okta and Salesforce via MFA Push Bombing' (reach_score=82, conf=85)

hypotheses.behavior: T1621 - Multi-Factor Authentication Request Generation (MFA push bombing)
hypotheses.finding_summary: 3 accounts received >10 MFA push requests within a 4-minute window from IP 203.0.113.12. Two accounts belong to Salesforce admin group. Timing matches the threat report's infrastructure IPs.

hypotheses.behavior: T1598.002 - Phishing for Information: Spearphishing Attachment (SIM swap follow-on)
hypotheses.finding_summary: No spearphishing attachment activity detected in 7-day window for the two flagged accounts. O365 audit logs present and healthy.

detection_artifacts.name: RR - Identity - MFA Push Bombing from Known Bad IP
detection_artifacts.spl: index=okta sourcetype=OktaIM2:log eventType=user.mfa.attempt outcome.result=FAILURE earliest=-15m | stats count by src_ip, user | where count > 8 | lookup threat_iocs value as src_ip OUTPUT actor, confidence | where isnotnull(actor)
